action.objective: Verify f3d4 recapture: assess material balance, king safety and whether Black can win material after Nxd4.
action.rationale: f3d4 is the reserved verification candidate and top broad-search move (exact 31 at depth 3). Recapturing the d4 pawn restores material balance and opens the c1 bishop diagonal. Must verify single-candidate at full depth before committing.
